title: Nobiletin ameliorates intervertebral disc degeneration by upregulating HIF-1alpha to inhibit endoplasmic reticulum stress-induced apoptosis.
authors: Jin, Yangcan; Chen, Kaiye; Chen, Hao; Ding, Huaze; Chen, Xianpeng; Jiang, Luyi; Yu, Heng; Lin, Zhongke
one_liner_zh: 该文研究川陈皮素通过上调HIF-1alpha抑制内质网应激凋亡来改善椎间盘退变，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是细胞凋亡与疾病治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) is a significant factor in the etiology of low back pain (LBP); however, existing therapeutic interventions remain inadequate. Growing evidence suggests that endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS) induced by oxidative stress (OS) promotes apoptosis of nucleus pulposus cells (NPCs) and degradation of the extracellular matrix (ECM), which is a significant pathogenic mechanism of IDD. Nobiletin (NOB), a polymethoxylated flavonoid derived from citrus peels, showcases anti-inflammatory and antioxidative characteristics. Nevertheless, the therapeutic connection with IDD has yet to be thoroughly investigated. This study aimed to demonstrate the protective effects of NOB against ERS induced by tert-butyl hydroperoxide (TBHP) in vitro, and against IDD induced by needle puncture in a rat model in vivo. Therefore, combining network pharmacology and molecular docking identified HIF-1alpha as a key target, a finding that was subsequently stabilized and validated by molecular dynamics simulations. Western blotting (WB) and immunofluorescence (IF) were used to detect protein expression in vitro. TUNEL staining and Flow cytometry analysis were used to detect apoptosis. Furthermore, utilizing a needle puncture-induced IDD model, the in vivo efficacy of NOB was evaluated by magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), X-ray, HE staining, safranin O-fast green (SO) staining, and immunohistochemical (IHC) staining. The findings demonstrate that NOB elevates HIF-1alpha expression to suppress ERS, thereby reducing apoptosis and slowing ECM degradation. In vivo experiments revealed that NOB ameliorates the progression of IDD. In conclusion, these findings highlight NOB's potential as a promising novel therapeutic strategy for IDD.
abstract_zh: 椎间盘退变（IDD）是腰痛（LBP）病因中的一个重要因素；然而，现有的治疗干预措施仍显不足。越来越多的证据表明，由氧化应激（OS）诱导的内质网应激（ERS）促进髓核细胞（NPCs）凋亡及细胞外基质（ECM）降解，这是IDD的一个重要致病机制。川陈皮素（NOB），一种源自柑橘果皮的多甲氧基黄酮类化合物，展现出抗炎和抗氧化特性。尽管如此，其与IDD的治疗关联尚未得到深入探究。本研究旨在证明NOB在体外对叔丁基过氧化氢（TBHP）诱导的ERS的保护作用，以及在体内通过针刺诱导的大鼠模型中对抗IDD的作用。因此，结合网络药理学和分子对接，鉴定出HIF-1α为关键靶点，这一发现随后通过分子动力学模拟得到稳定和验证。采用蛋白质印迹法（WB）和免疫荧光（IF）检测体外蛋白表达。使用TUNEL染色和流式细胞术分析检测细胞凋亡。此外，利用针刺诱导的IDD模型，通过磁共振成像（MRI）、X射线、HE染色、番红O-固绿（SO）染色及免疫组织化学（IHC）染色评估NOB的体内疗效。结果表明，NOB通过上调HIF-1α表达来抑制ERS，从而减少细胞凋亡并减缓ECM降解。体内实验揭示，NOB能改善IDD的进展。总之，这些发现凸显了NOB作为IDD一种有前景的新型治疗策略的潜力。
